user.title: Configure FastALPR
user.description: Select a camera and optional vehicle-detection sensor. FastALPR inference runs in the separate FastALPR Inference app. Enter its internal URL, such as http://APP-HOSTNAME:8099. Known plates remain private in Home Assistant.

data.backend_url: Inference app URL (Home Assistant internal network)
